name: Tórtola de Henares (Spain)
description: A red isosceles triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly bearing a yellow tower, the upper triangle white and the lower triangle white with two blue wavy stripes.
history: Tórtola de Henares adopted its arms and flag officially on 17 October 2005; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of a red isosceles triangle with its base at the hoist and its point at the fly, the upper triangle white and the lower white with two blue waves separated by a white wave of half their width.
